name: Seeker of a Just Night
source:
Just Night is the cool kid everyone wants to sit with, but he will ignore you if you're not worth his time. Stunning and stoic, he values his fairness and moral uprightness above all else and isn't afraid to call someone out for being unjust. He's known Billie since middle school, much to his displeasure.

[From [url=https://banana-ooyu.itch.io/one-just-night]itch.io[/url]]
